io.milvus.v2.service.vector.request

Class SearchIteratorReqV2

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.v2.service.vector.request.SearchIteratorReqV2

  • public class SearchIteratorReqV2
extends Object
    Request parameters for a V2 search iterator, specifying the collection, vectors, metric type, limit, filter, and other search options. Built via SearchIteratorReqV2.SearchIteratorReqV2Builder.
